Editing a route

The rest of the network is hidden so you can focus. Drag any point to move it, click a highlighted line to add a point there, or click a point then use the buttons below. Removing a point where two segments join merges them into one; removing a point at the very start or end of the route isn't allowed.

      Edit path

      Stair section

      Mark its first and last point. The rest of the path stays unchanged.

      Place an entrance / exit

      Choose the building, then click its door on the map. Drag the marker to adjust it.
